The '''Missile Hold''' was a large area onboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] in which racks of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] were stored for launch. [[Lumiya]] and [[Alema Rar]] sneaked into the Hold around [[40 ABY/Legends|the time]] of the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} shakedown cruise to arm themselves for one of Lumiya's [[Duel on Roqoo Depot|plots]].
